Shifter Transformation:
If a player sleeps in Ferrytown parks for a cumulative 7 days, their race permanently becomes shifter unless they are fey. When replacing your race with shifter, you lose all racial features from your original race, apart from any flying, swimming, or climbing speed and all but one of any proficiencies granted by your race. To clarify, a player will lose one racial proficiency of their choice (if their race had no proficiencies this has no effect) and all non-proficiency, non-flying, swimming, or climbing speed features from their original race. They will replace their original ability score improvements with those from their shifter subrace, and gain all appropriate shifter features apart from languages and proficiencies. Players are the same size class as their original race. Which shifter subrace a player is will be up to DMD/mariam depending on their animal, though most will be given a choice between two options. For example, someone who becomes a bear shifter might be a longtooth or a beasthide shifter.
